scope: Accepted R38 editorial sheet for the analysis page: edition bar, four chapters, warm paper tokens, 50px/28px number hierarchy, editorial tables and native details, with all original analytics, CLI and tool content restored inside those chapters. The repaired local preview and its fake data are not product sources.
dataRule: Illustrative source data is replaced by actual native Codex usage, squad receipts, recorded verification notes and official release metadata. Benefits use the saved snapshot only: fixed savings titles, real signed values, negative means more input than the baseline and is never flipped positive; missing values stay 未上报. No quota inference or raw file fingerprints in user UI.

latestDecision.decision: Use the complete Warm Editorial source as the visual basis; original HTML/CSS untouched. Exact exported component selectors are scoped to the report, with existing business hooks sharing those same rules. Four chapters and stable fixed-layout tables replace the old analysis visual layer. Restore omitted existing capabilities using the original table/fold/footer patterns, not demo data or script. Keep R46/R47 loading/header behavior and prior signed benefit requirements.

r40Decision.decision: Local refinement of the accepted R38 sheet, not a new整体稿. Chapter order becomes 01 benefits, 02 consumption, 03 skills and CLI, 04 observations, keeping id="directives" and its jump. Chapter 02 opens with four real cards (total, input, cached inside input, output) on a 4/2/1 symmetric grid before any distribution; Codex, Qoder and compare share one distribution-table shell and column set, single mode reserves the comparison second line so card height never changes, and the squad-level fact grid also uses 4/2/1. Every populated analysis table sorts through table-model.mjs with raw values and unknown last. CLI gains a category select intersected with a literal multi-term input search that preserves caret and IME composition. The Stitch demo numbers, dates and conclusions are not adopted, and the real -20.93M / about -54 minutes, four recommendations, 17 skills, 449 commands and all drilldowns are preserved.

r40LocalRefinement.adopted: token-cards-grid/token-stat-card, shared distribution table shell, sort header button with aria-sort, CLI search + select layout, chapter order.
r40LocalRefinement.notAdopted: Percentages, call counts, dates, benefit signs and business conclusions in the Stitch demo.

boardDecision.decision: Container-width driven stacked full-width lanes for narrow embedded panels and three flexible lanes at >=960 content width, with compact empty lanes. Inside each lane, cards flow in an auto-fill CSS grid whose tracks follow the card list's real width (min 260px, 12px gap); all cards in a row are equal-height flex columns with a bottom-anchored meta block. The first flex draft board-fluid-cards-original.html is superseded and not consumed.

Readable chapter names and warm ochre negative state; existing shared shell preserved.
Full skills and CLI retain all records with three-entry previews; CLI methodology is available in details.
mainIntegration.fontSource: 9c0ee3ac4db172bcba01.css appended after legacy font faces: preserves Newsreader variable weight 300..700 from exact adopted design, without changing font bytes.

Update the pre-existing chapter assertion for user-authorized section order.

businessStateAdaptations: The source demo dropped the total in compare mode; the product keeps both parties' real totals side by side as provider-row + token-hero-val inside the hero, never summed and never replaced by text.

The source demo compared a single flow value; the product's compare cells stack the two provider rows in a shared 36px value slot, so all three modes keep one card height without any reserved or blank row.
The flow label reserves 19px (pill height) so a cell without a ratio pill keeps the same height as cells with one.

The input ratio pill is omitted because ModelUsageTotals does not expose the raw-input numerator; it is not back-derived from formatted K/M/B strings. Cached uses cacheShare and output uses shares.output.
Missing totals show 未上报 and missing cache shows 未记录 at the same type size as real values (color only changes), so switching modes never resizes the hero.
All numbers come from ModelUsageTotals/reportModel; the source demo figures, '100%' copy, page globals, specimen footer and explanatory demo text are not adopted.
